envelope.description: Rewrite the cross-client integration test 'Installer and updated CLI, VS Code and JetBrains route matrix'

body.title: Rewrite the cross-client integration test 'Installer and updated CLI, VS Code and JetBrains route matrix'
body.summary: Rewrite src/daemon/__tests__/macos-upgrade-routing.test.ts so its unmanaged-checkout assertions expect a plain git-fetch+npm-install+npm-build sequence (no authorize/npm ci/npm run/prepare-legacy-upgrade trace events) across all four surfaces (raw installer, daemon-ctl.sh update, vscode-plugin's run('update'), jetbrains-plugin's DaemonLifecycleCommandRunnerTest bridge), while adding a second fixture for a genuinely managed checkout whose assertions are left exactly as the test's current managed-path behavior.
acceptanceChecks: The rewritten test's unmanaged-fixture assertions show no authorize/npm-ci/npm-run/prepare-legacy-upgrade trace events across all four surfaces, and all four complete successfully.
The rewritten test's new managed-fixture assertions show the signed bridge still engaging for all four surfaces, unchanged from today.

tests.name: src/daemon/__tests__/macos-upgrade-routing.test.ts: 'Installer and updated CLI, VS Code and JetBrains route matrix' (rewritten)
